location.site_area_note: Project Skyway area northeast of Pine Island, partially in the City of Pine Island and Pine Island Township; exact data-center parcel/street address remains unpublished in reviewed sources.

status_as_of_cutoff: Local process / construction halted as of 2026-08-11. Pine Island's Project Skyway page documents AUAR adoption, local land-use/development-agreement actions, and a 482-acre project area. Google and Xcel announced the Pine Island data center and energy collaboration on 2026-02-24. Minnesota PUC identifies the Xcel/Echo Zone electric service agreement for the Pine Island data center as Docket 26-170, filed 2026-04-14 and still under Commission review with public comments open to 2026-09-08. Minnesota PUC also lists the associated Skyway 345 kV transmission-line project, Docket 26-135, as active. A Goodhue County temporary restraining order reported in May 2026 halted construction/pre-construction activity while environmental-review litigation proceeds. No public Google IT-load/building-count figure, final utility approval, energization, commissioning, or live-service evidence was located.

actions.result_status: City Project Skyway materials state that the City Council approved distribution of the scoping EAW and draft order for review; the environmental study was conducted as an AUAR evaluating light-industrial/technology campus and technology-campus/data-center scenarios.
actions.access_caveat: Official city project page; underlying meeting packet not separately retrieved in this refresh.
actions.evidence_note: Tier-1 local-government evidence for environmental-review process, not construction.

actions.result_status: City Project Skyway schedule lists Resolution 25-42 approving adoption of the Final AUAR.
actions.access_caveat: Project information site schedule; city page confirms AUAR adoption but full packet/order not retrieved because the linked AUAR PDF is very large.

actions.action_type: local land-use and development agreement approvals
actions.result_status: Project Skyway schedule lists City Council action on final plat, rezoning, planned unit development, and city development agreement, with listed actions in this schedule marked unanimously approved.
actions.access_caveat: Project information site schedule; individual adopted ordinances/agreements were not separately retrieved.
actions.evidence_note: Local-process evidence; not treated as building permit, start of construction, or energization.

actions.result_status: Google announced a new Pine Island data center and collaboration with the City of Pine Island, without publishing a project-specific IT load, building count, permit, or construction date.
actions.access_caveat: Company announcement; city collaboration is not a zoning or building approval.

actions.result_status: Xcel announced plans to power Google's new Minnesota data center and described a 1,900 MW clean-energy support program. The 1,900 MW figure is generation/storage support and is not treated as Pine Island IT load.
actions.access_caveat: Utility announcement; no site-specific interconnection or energization record was exposed.
actions.evidence_note: Energy context kept separate from facility capacity.

actions.result_status: PUC data-center page lists the Xcel Energy and Echo Zone, LLC electric service agreement for a Pine Island data center as filed on 2026-04-14 in Docket 26-170; public comments remain open until 2026-09-08 before Commission deliberation.
actions.access_caveat: PUC page is public, but eDockets document downloads returned access errors during this refresh; no confidential demand/load value is inferred.
actions.evidence_note: Tier-1 state-utility-regulator evidence; pending service-agreement review.

actions.result_status: PUC Energy Infrastructure Permitting lists the Skyway 345 kV Transmission Line Project, Docket 26-135, as active and shows the proposed 1.2-mile double-circuit 345 kV line connecting four new substations to the existing North Rochester Substation, with an application-completeness determination dated 2026-05-12.
actions.access_caveat: State project page is public; it documents active permitting, not an issued route permit or energized line.
actions.evidence_note: Tier-1 state-regulator evidence for grid interconnection/permitting process.

actions.result_status: MPR reported that a Goodhue County judge issued a temporary restraining order barring construction while environmental-review litigation proceeds.

actions.access_caveat: Secondary report dated 2026-05-26; the underlying signed court order and docket were not retrieved, so no additional legal scope is inferred.
actions.evidence_note: Court-halt status is preserved as reported evidence, not a zoning approval.

actions.action_type: project water and cooling information update
actions.result_status: City Project Skyway page states the proposed project would not use water for cooling, would use municipal water/sewer rather than private wells, would use an estimated maximum of 152,000 gallons per day or less at full buildout, and plans air-cooled closed-loop cooling.
actions.access_caveat: Official city FAQ/project page; these are proposed design representations and not operational metered usage.
actions.evidence_note: Tier-1 local-government project representation; kept separate from IT-load/capacity.
